comment: The phase input is read as a voltage rather than as a pitch, PhO.cpp:63: minus five to five volts is one turn, so a saw at audio rate makes it an oscillator and a slow saw makes it a wavetable reader. The damping is an exponential curve over the harmonic number, PhO.cpp:59, and is applied only to harmonics whose strength is above zero. Only the first sixteen channels of Pts are read.
